description: Generic connector search (the shape ChatGPT connectors and deep research call). Search Thea (a place-first knowledge graph: 1.07M Korean places from public data, plus people, works and organizations) by name or by 'region + kind', e.g. '여주 온천', '명일동 중식', 'IU'. Returns ids to pass to fetch. If you can use thea_search / thea_find / thea_entry, prefer them: they give same-name candidates, filters, ratings and views.
name: search
